description: Source code for an interactive watch face service for Android Wear OS, demonstrating touch event handling and display updates.

classes.name: InteractiveWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class for the interactive watch face, extending CanvasWatchFaceService.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, handling drawing and touch events.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the Engine class.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, sets watch face style, and initializes paint and counters.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout and text size based on device shape (round or square).

methods.name: onPeekCardPositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates peek card bounds and triggers redraw.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles property changes like burn-in protection and low-bit ambient mode.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts anti-aliasing based on ambient mode.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap events, updating counters and touch coordinates.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background and event counters, touch coordinates, and peek card overlay.
